measurement_scope.prover: PIOP reduction only; input preparation, serialization, source checks and PCS excluded.
measurement_scope.verifier: Reduction replay only; no PCS. Binius switchover=6 uses seven small-field folds, no skipped messages.
measurement_scope.ram: Mikros/FLOCK: median of 3 fresh-process VmHWM readings immediately after proving, before verification/source checks; includes inputs and setup. Binius: VmHWM from its sole cold measured proof; no additional RAM run.
measurement_scope.sampling: Mikros/FLOCK: 10 measured proofs each after one excluded warmup. Binius: one cold measured proof, with no warmup.

metadata.carryless_scope: coeffclmul/coeffnibble encode directly to binary planes using 512 KiB byte or 64 KiB nibble tables; four-row VPCLMUL Karatsuba high convolution, AES reduction, decode and original register consumer; same 2048-row outer blocks as PairAggregate; all witness conversions online; safe original native/lookup fallback; corresponding reuse modes retain independent scratch capacity
